name: montaj-asr-{{ENVIRONMENT}}
description: Whisper large-v3-turbo + forced alignment + pyannote community-1, co-resident in one model server (decision D15). Serves ai.transcribe, ai.align and ai.diarise.

template.name: montaj-ai-worker-{{ENVIRONMENT}}
template.readme: Models are baked into the image, not downloaded at boot: a cold start that pulls 3 GB of weights costs more in GPU-seconds than the image layer cache costs in storage.

_notes.workersMin: Decision D15: a warm floor of one instance per region. A cold start on this image is 25-40 s; the first transcript of the morning must not pay it. One warm 24 GB GPU is roughly USD 290 a month at on-demand serverless rates, which is the single largest fixed line in the AI budget - see ../COST.md.
_notes.workersMax: Ceiling, not a target. Raise only with the credit admission control in mind (THREAT-MODEL T23): unbounded GPU autoscaling is unbounded spend.
_notes.scalerType: QUEUE_DELAY scales on how long a request has been waiting, which maps directly onto the transcript latency targets in 05 section 5.1 (p95 <= 120 s on the Scribe path). REQUEST_COUNT would scale on arrival rate and miss a slow queue.
_notes.scalerValue: Add a worker when the oldest queued request has waited 20 s.
_notes.idleTimeout: Seconds a worker stays alive after its last request. 30 s bridges the gap between chunks of the same media file without holding the GPU across jobs.
_notes.executionTimeoutMs: 30 minutes. A 3-hour source is chunked at VAD boundaries into ~10-minute pieces (05 section 5.1), so no single request should come close.
_notes.gpuIds: 24 GB Ada (L4, A5000) or Ampere (A10, 3090). large-v3-turbo plus the aligner and the diariser co-resident need about 11 GB; 24 GB leaves room for a second concurrent stream.
_notes.locations: AP first for Indian users and for the residency story in 05 section 9. EU and US are listed for overflow only; the routing layer must not send Indian media there while the transfer impact assessment (05 section 8) is outstanding.
_notes.flashboot: RunPod keeps the container image warm across scale-to-zero. Halves the cold start at no extra cost.
